purpose: Emphasize a reason as precisely what makes the result true.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
express feelings speak politely show respect
I told you the truth precisely because I care about you.
It was precisely because I failed that I understood the importance of preparation.
Continuing every day is exactly what brought me this far.
restrictions: こそ focuses the reason as especially decisive.
mistake: Do not use it when no causal emphasis is intended.

segments.role: Emphasize a reason as precisely what makes the result true. Plain clause + からこそ
